mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mac_user (user_name, user_pwd, group_id, user_points, user_status, user_reg_time, user_reg_ip, user_openid_qq, user_openid_weixin) SELECT #{name}, #{pwd}, 2, #{points}, #{status}, #{now}, #{ip}, '', '' FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mac_user AS u WHERE u.user_name = #{name}) AND (#{regNum} <= 0 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mac_user AS r WHERE r.user_reg_ip = #{ip} AND r.user_reg_time > #{since}) < #{regNum})
mapper.update: UPDATE mac_user SET user_last_login_time = user_login_time, user_last_login_ip = user_login_ip, user_login_time = #{now}, user_login_ip = #{ip}, user_login_num = user_login_num + 1, user_random = #{random}, group_id = IF(group_id > 2 AND user_end_time < #{now}, 2, group_id) WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND user_pwd = #{pwd} AND user_status = 1
